def render_g_cost_warehouse(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Get the primary dataframe (shipment_quality.csv)
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        # Draw empty placeholder
        pdf.set_fill_color(230, 230, 230)
        pdf.rect(x, y, w, h, style='F')
        pdf.set_xy(x, y + h/2 - 3)
        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'I', 8)
        pdf.cell(w, 6, 'Dados não disponíveis', align='C')
        return

    # Aggregate total cost per warehouse
    cost_by_warehouse = df.groupby('warehouse', as_index=False)['cost'].sum()
    cost_by_warehouse = cost_by_warehouse.sort_values('cost', ascending=False)

    # Create bar chart
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4), constrained_layout=True)

    # Professional color palette
    colors = ['#4C72B0', '#55A868', '#C44E52']
    bars = ax.bar(
        cost_by_warehouse['warehouse'],
        cost_by_warehouse['cost'],
        color=colors[:len(cost_by_warehouse)],
        edgecolor='white',
        linewidth=0.8
    )

    # Title and labels in Portuguese
    ax.set_title("Custo Total por Armazém", fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', pad=8)
    ax.set_xlabel("Armazém", fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Custo Total (R$)", fontsize=8)

    # Format y-axis as currency
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: f'R$ {x:,.0f}'))

    # Set y-axis limit for label headroom (20% above max)
    max_val = cost_by_warehouse['cost'].max()
    ax.set_ylim(0, max_val * 1.25)

    # Add value labels on top of bars
    ax.bar_label(bars, fmt='R$ {:,.0f}', padding=3, fontsize=7)

    # Clean styling: remove top/right spines
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='both', labelsize=7)

    # Save and insert into PDF
    import tempfile, os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close(fig)
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_late_trend_week(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Get the primary dataframe
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return
    
    # Prepare data: ensure required columns exist
    required = ['week', 'warehouse', 'late_pct']
    if not all(col in df.columns for col in required):
        return
    
    # Sort by week to ensure chronological order
    df = df[required].copy()
    # Ensure week order (string sort works for YYYY-Wxx format)
    df = df.sort_values('week')
    
    # Get unique warehouses and a color palette
    warehouses = sorted(df['warehouse'].unique())
    colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', n_colors=len(warehouses))
    
    # Create figure
    fig_width = w / 25.4
    fig_height = h / 25.4
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(fig_width, fig_height), constrained_layout=False)
    
    # Plot each warehouse
    for idx, wh in enumerate(warehouses):
        wh_data = df[df['warehouse'] == wh]
        ax.plot(wh_data['week'], wh_data['late_pct'], 
                marker='o', linewidth=1.5, color=colors[idx], label=wh)
    
    # Configure axes
    ax.set_xlabel('Semana', fontsize=7)
    ax.set_ylabel('Percentual de Atraso (%)', fontsize=7)
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=6)
    ax.set_title('Evolução do Atraso por Semana e Armazém', fontsize=9, pad=6)
    
    # Legend outside below
    ax.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.15), 
              ncol=len(warehouses), frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.22)  # reserve space for legend
    
    # Adjust top margin for title
    fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.82)
    
    # Remove x-axis tick labels rotation? Keep as is.
    plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0, ha='center')
    
    # Save to temp file and insert into PDF
    import tempfile, os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close(fig)
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_incident_composition(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Access the explicit dataframe from the component columns
    df = dataframes.get('incident_log.xlsx')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        # If no data available, draw a placeholder text
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "I", 8)
        pdf.cell(w, h, "Dados de incidentes indisponíveis", align="C")
        return

        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "I", 8)
        pdf.cell(w, h, "Colunas necessárias não encontradas", align="C")
        return

    # Pivot to create stacked bar data (warehouse x incident_type)
    try:
        pivot = df.pivot_table(
            index='warehouse',
            columns='incident_type',
            values='count',
            aggfunc='sum',
            fill_value=0

    except Exception:
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "I", 8)
        pdf.cell(w, h, "Erro ao reorganizar dados", align="C")
        return

    # If pivot is empty, nothing to plot
    if pivot.empty:
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "I", 8)
        pdf.cell(w, h, "Sem dados para exibir", align="C")
        return

    # Create the matplotlib figure with exact dimensions (mm -> inch)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4))

    # Plot stacked bars
    pivot.plot(
        kind='bar',
        stacked=True,
        ax=ax,
        color=sns.color_palette("Set2", n_colors=len(pivot.columns))
    )

    # Title (inside the figure, small and bold)
    ax.set_title("Distribuição de incidentes por tipo e armazém",
                 fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', pad=8)

    # Axis labels
    ax.set_xlabel("Armazém", fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Quantidade de incidentes", fontsize=8)

    # Format ticks
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=7)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=7)

    # Legends: place below the chart to avoid overlap
    if len(pivot.columns) > 1:
        box = ax.get_position()
        ax.set_position([box.x0, box.y0 + box.height * 0.18,
                         box.width, box.height * 0.82])
        ax.legend(
            loc='upper center',
            bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.18),
            ncol=min(len(pivot.columns), 4),
            frameon=False,
            fontsize=7
        )

    # Remove top/right spines for cleaner look
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

    # Save to temporary file and insert into PDF
    import tempfile
    import os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close(fig)

import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR', '/tmp/matplotlib')
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from fpdf import FPDF, XPos, YPos
import tempfile
import textwrap

sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid')

def _safe_pdf_text(value):
    replacements = {
        '\u2013': '-', '\u2014': '-', '\u2015': '-',
        '\u2018': "'", '\u2019': "'", '\u201c': '"', '\u201d': '"',
        '\u2022': '-', '\u00a0': ' ', '\u2026': '...'
    }
    text = str(value or '')
    for source, target in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(source, target)
    return text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')

def _wrap_lines(text, max_chars):
    lines = []
    for paragraph in str(text).splitlines() or ['']:
        wrapped = textwrap.wrap(paragraph.strip(), width=max_chars) or ['']
        lines.extend(wrapped)
    return lines

def _sentence_chunks(text):
    normalized = ' '.join(str(text).split())
    chunks, current = [], []
    for token in normalized.split(' '):
        current.append(token)
        if token.rstrip().endswith(('.', '!', '?', ';')):
            chunks.append(' '.join(current))
            current = []
    if current:
        chunks.append(' '.join(current))
    return chunks or [normalized]

def _fit_text_to_box(text, w, h, font_size, line_height):
    max_chars = max(14, int(w * 0.55 * (10 / max(font_size, 1))))
    max_lines = max(1, int(h / max(line_height, 1)))
    if len(_wrap_lines(text, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
        return text
    selected = []
    for sentence in _sentence_chunks(text):
        candidate = ' '.join(selected + [sentence]).strip()
        if not candidate:
            continue
        if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
            selected.append(sentence)
        elif selected:
            break
        else:
            words = sentence.split()
            compact = []
            for word in words:
                candidate = ' '.join(compact + [word])
                if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) > max_lines:
                    break
                compact.append(word)
            selected.append(' '.join(compact))
            break
    fitted = ' '.join(selected).strip()
    return fitted

def _write_report_title(pdf, title, font_family):
    clean_title = ' '.join(_safe_pdf_text(title or 'Relatório Analítico').split())
    for size in range(16, 10, -1):
        max_chars = max(28, int(58 * (16 / size)))
        lines = textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=max_chars) or [clean_title]
        if len(lines) <= 2:
            pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', size)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, '\n'.join(lines), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')
            return
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 11)
    pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=84)), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')

def render_text_block(pdf, text, x, y, w, h, title=None):
    font_size = 10
    line_height = 5
    text = _safe_pdf_text(text)
    title = _safe_pdf_text(title) if title else None
    body_height = h
    pdf.set_xy(x, y)
    if title:
        pdf.set_font('helvetica', 'B', font_size)
        pdf.cell(w, 7, title, new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT)
        body_height = max(1, h - 8)
        pdf.set_xy(x, pdf.get_y())
    
    fitted_text = _fit_text_to_box(text, w, body_height, font_size, line_height)
    pdf.set_font('helvetica', '', font_size)
    pdf.multi_cell(w, line_height, fitted_text, align='J')

def render_g_damage_late_scatter(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Retrieve the dataset
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None:
        df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # Prepare figure with correct size (mm -> inches)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4))

    # Color palette for up to 6 distinct warehouses
    palette = ['#4C72B0', '#DD8452', '#55A868', '#C44E52', '#8172B2', '#937860']
    warehouses = df['warehouse'].unique()
    colors = {wh: palette[i] for i, wh in enumerate(warehouses)}

    # Scatter plot per warehouse
    for wh in warehouses:
        subset = df[df['warehouse'] == wh]
        ax.scatter(subset['late_pct'], subset['damage_pct'],
                   label=wh, color=colors[wh], s=50, alpha=0.8, edgecolors='k')

    # Labels and title in Portuguese
    ax.set_xlabel('Percentual de Atraso (%)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel('Percentual de Avaria (%)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title('Relação entre Avaria e Atraso por Armazém', fontsize=9, pad=8)
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=7)
    ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

    # Legend outside chart (bottom)
    ax.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.18),
              ncol=min(3, len(warehouses)), frameon=False, fontsize=6)

    # Adjust layout to prevent clipping of title and legend
    fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.30, top=0.88, left=0.15, right=0.95)

    # Save as image and insert into PDF
    import tempfile
    import os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
